analysis_notes: EVAS saves requested observation times, not every event time. Native event log used for event sequence and checked against sampled counter. An initial in-memory analysis attempt detected a count jump; no simulator result was changed. Sparse-output calibration now covers this.

First remote preflight failed before Spectre invocation because Python supplied a relative __file__. Retried with an absolute runner path and unchanged frozen files. Current runner resolves paths explicitly.
First successful analysis is retained in runs/cross-restart-20261004-r1-analysis.json; v2 adds switch-step measurements, preserving verdicts and executions.
Controls use a predeclared 1e-10 V diagnostic target, 2e-9 s event target, exact count=2; these are NOT replacements for earlier triangle benchmark criteria.
Original model has no unique event-count oracle in this experiment. Counts are observations, not pass/fail evidence.
Observed traponly zero increments across opposite endpoint slopes are consistent with trapezoidal cancellation, not proof of closed-source internal history implementation.
No cross-backend tolerance mapping, speed ratio, new holdout, or general accuracy qualification claimed.
availability: Inputs, runner, calibration and compact receipt in repository. Raw inputs/outputs and prior runner revisions in ignored local runs archives and authorized thu-sui storage; not publicly downloadable.
